title: deotte-commute-x-anxiety
hypothesis: Range anxiety in EV adoption is acutely operationalized by daily driving distance. Adding a commute_x_anxiety interaction helper (Daily_Commute_km * [Range_Anxiety_Level == High]) to FeatureBuilder informs the trees that High range anxiety suppresses purchase probability primarily when Daily_Commute_km is large, lifting CV beyond 0.94558.
